2607.05365.title: SPEARBench: A Benchmark for Naturalness Evaluation in Streaming Speech-to-Speech Language Models
2607.05365.paper_summary: Streaming speech-to-speech language models aim to answer spoken queries directly with synthetic speech. However, standard speech and text benchmarks do not capture whether these systems behave naturally in conversations, where timing, turn-taking, prosody, interpersonal stance, language and dialect consistency, and relationship-aware appropriateness jointly shape perceived quality. We introduce SPEARBench, a benchmark for evaluating naturalness in speech-to-speech language models from question-answer interactions. SPEARBench constructs controlled dialogue prompts from the Seamless Interaction corpus, runs inference across multiple models, and evaluates generated answers using a multidimensional protocol that covers response latency, interruptions, speech quality, ASR robustness, language and dialect consistency, emotional naturalness, interpersonal stance, and explainable distributional baselines. The benchmark includes original human answers as a reference condition and reports results for several contemporary models. Results show that current models can achieve high signal-level quality and low ASR error while still differing from human conversational behavior in latency, overlap, dialect preservation, emotional adaptation, and interpersonal stance dynamics.
2607.05365.paper_summary_zh: 串流語音到語音的語言模型旨在直接用合成語音回答口語查詢。<lb/>然而，標準的語音和文本基準無法捕捉這些系統在對話中是否表現自然，因為時間、輪流發言、韻律、人際立場、語言和方言的一致性以及關係意識的適當性共同塑造了感知質量。<lb/>我們介紹了SPEARBench，一個用於評估語音到語音語言模型在問答互動中自然性的基準。<lb/>SPEARBench從無縫互動語料庫構建受控對話提示，對多個模型進行推理，並使用涵蓋響應延遲、中斷、語音質量、ASR穩健性、語言和方言一致性、情感自然性、人際立場和可解釋的分佈基準的多維協議來評估生成的答案。<lb/>該基準包括原始人類答案作為參考條件，並報告幾個當代模型的結果。<lb/>結果顯示，當前模型可以實現高信號級質量和低ASR錯誤，同時在延遲、重疊、方言保留、情感適應和人際立場動態方面仍與人類對話行為存在差異。
